last_edition.label: 2026 RVOD Freeride and Tour de Maryhill

next_edition.label: 2027, 20th anniversary; one event only, weekend between late May and Labor Day still being chosen

add_sources.note: 15 Sep 2026: Ratz Freerides started in 2007 and grew to 4 events a year; 'In 2027, our 20th anniversary, we will only be putting on one event'; Labor Day not preferred; options 'between the 3rd week in May to Labor Day weekend'.

'We also want to thank our current sponsors, Johnson Gravity Racing, Woodinville CPA, Eastside Longboards, Skate School of Santa Fe'; thanks to The Maryhill Museum of Art (owner of the Maryhill Loops Road) and The Wolfe Family. 'Please contact the Ratz for sponsorship opportunities.'

add_gaps: Site invites sponsorship enquiries ('Please contact the Ratz') but publishes no email or contact page
notes: Frequency changes from biannual to a single annual event in 2027 (20th anniversary), date not yet set, so the April 2027 Spring Freeride expectation no longer holds. Sponsors are small endemic businesses; scale is a few hundred riders at most (not published).
